method: Sort eligible row ids by sha256('dialogue-audit-v1|' + row_id); take two per declared stratum without replacement.

correcting_targeted.scope_note: Purposefully enriched for truth and misquotation cases. These 12 dialogues cannot estimate corpus-wide rates.

convskills_lane_stratified.scope_note: Two dialogues per final lane. This supports lane coverage inspection; n=2 per lane is too small for a stable failure-rate estimate.
